description: §19.16.5 — a body-split function whose FIRST server batch (batch 0) fails still runs its deferred bodies on the way out: the batch's error return is an exit of the function body. Every batch is stubbed to fail, so batch 0 fails, the client work after it never runs, but @busy is cleared and "D;" is appended exactly once: trace = "start;D;", @busy = false. (The true intermediate-batch failure — batch 0 ok, batch 1 fails — is `cps-batch1-failure`.)
rationale: §19.16.2 lists the implicit CPS failure return among the exits that run every registered deferred body exactly once; §19.16.5: the deferred body also runs when a batch fails and the function returns its error envelope (§19.6.7).
